firstPlayerRule: Deal one card to each player. The player whose card is closest to 1999 goes first; a jump card counts as zero for this comparison.
houseFallback: If the official instruction leaves an unresolved tie or cannot be applied, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: The starter places their pawn on the red “Firsts” space; others place pawns clockwise on the next categories. Return the drawn cards to the deck and reshuffle.
The player on “Firsts” starts the game.
